text: The authors define recursive reward modeling: agent A1 is trained with reward modeling from user feedback, and at step k agent A(k-1) assists the user in evaluating outcomes when training agent A(k), for example by giving auxiliary information, summarising large data, interpreting A(k)'s internals, or solving sub-problems the user has carved off. They note the assisting task differs from the task A(k) is trained on.
title: Recursive reward modeling: agent A(k-1) assists the user in evaluating agent A(k)
